% Converted, ltx-talk. This is what scripts/fix_frame_titles.py produces --
% a real brace matcher, run AFTER convert_deck.py, which is the documented
% workaround for C-FRAMETITLE-NESTED. The double form is joined with " --- ".
% Note \sc also had to become \scshape: the obsolete two-letter font commands
% are undefined under ltx-talk (C-OLDFONT), and this is exactly the kind of
% title that hides one.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard=a-4, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[c]
\frametitle{\only<1>{Example}\only<2>{Find a plan for}}
Single braced title, nested.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[c]
\frametitle{Arc consistency --- {\scshape Inference}}
Double braced title, nested.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
